applies_to: expenses paid from 2021-01-01 (quotes + deposit before then exempt)
content: Works open the right to MPR only if done by a firm holding the RGE qualification for that specific category of works (17 categories listed); when a firm does several works, only categories covered by its RGE sign are eligible. Energy auditor qualification aligned on décret 30 May 2018.
ne_note: Firm-side: category-specific RGE requirement. Exposure varies with the firm's pre-2021 RGE portfolio. Coincides with the 2021 opening of MPR, so hard to isolate.

content: External wall insulation (ITE): forfaits revised and 100 m2 surface cap introduced. Works started 15 Jul-31 Aug 2020 may apply after starting (until 1 Nov 2020). For ITE expenses paid 15 Jul-31 Dec 2020, the prime is topped up to the CITE amount if lower.
ne_note: Small, ITE-specific adjustment during the CITE-to-MPR transition.

applies_to: applications filed from 2021-01-01; ex-post applications for violet/rose works started 2020-10-01..12-31 on quotes signed then
content: Opening to intermediate (violet) and upper (rose) income owner-occupants; to landlords (from 2021-07-01 until 2022-12-31) and other real-right holders (from 2021-07-01). Four income categories defined (intermediate/upper ceilings set in arrêté annex). New forfaits: AMO and rénovation globale (individual houses only), bonuses 'sortie de passoire' and 'BBC' (2021-2022). Écrêtement: MPR + CEE + other aids cannot leave less than a set share of cost at the household's charge, by income category. ANAH does not pay/recover primes under 80 EUR.
ne_note: Income category x time: violet/rose enter on 2021-01-01 (France Relance, CITE closure). Anticipation risk: announced Sept 2020 and retroactive window from 2020-10-01, so treat Oct 2020 as start or drop Q4 2020. CITE phase-out is a concurrent confounder for violet/rose.

content: Composition and referral rules of the ANAH sanctions commission (mandataires, fraud).
Personal data processing: ANAH data may be shared with ministries, SDES (statistics), DGFiP, anti-fraud services, RGE bodies; retention periods.
ne_note: Not a treatment, but relevant for data access (SDES transmission explicitly allowed).

content: Landlords (eligible from 2021-07-01): commitment to cap rent increases (prime deducted) and inform tenant; 5-year rental counted from prime payment. Legal persons explicitly excluded. Overseas: three DROM-specific forfaits; DROM excluded from rénovation globale and bonuses. ITE: CEE counted in the calculation regardless of the 100 m2 cap.
ne_note: Landlord entry on 2021-07-01: owner-occupied vs rented dwellings. Landlord take-up was reportedly low.

content: Dwelling must be at least 15 years old at grant notification (previously over 2 years), except fuel-oil boiler replacement combined with tank removal. Minimum occupancy 8 months per year. Owner must occupy as main residence within 1 year of balance request. Works deadline extended to 2 years (1 year with advance). Forfaits for closed fireplaces/inserts raised.
ne_note: Construction-year discontinuity: dwellings aged 2-15 years lose eligibility for applications from 2022-01-01 (except fuel-oil replacement). DiD / RD by construction cohort. Published 31 Dec 2021, but likely anticipated in Q4 2021.

applies_to: applications filed 2022-04-15..2022-12-31 (extended to 2023-03-31 by arrêté 29 déc. 2022)
content: Plan de résilience: +1,000 EUR for blue/yellow/violet on auto biomass boiler (10000/8000/4000 -> 11000/9000/5000), manual biomass boiler, solar heating, geothermal heat pump (10000/8000/4000 -> 11000/9000/5000), air-water heat pump (4000/3000/2000 -> 5000/4000/3000). Caps unchanged. Heat-pump water heaters (CET), stoves, insulation unchanged.
ne_note: Geste x time. Air-water heat pump vs CET contrast is clean (CET flat at 1200/800/400). Published 3 days before taking effect; announced in March 2022 plan (date to verify). End of bonus on 2023-04-01 gives a reversal event.

content: Very-high-performance gas boilers removed from eligible works (forfait was 1200/800 for blue/yellow, nothing for violet/rose). Décret 2022-1451 also revises data-sharing (recipients, retention).
ne_note: Exit of a geste, announced ~9 months ahead, so expect pull-forward of gas-boiler applications in 2022. Exposure: gas-boiler installers' share of MPR activity.

content: Overseas (DROM): dwelling age requirement over 2 years (vs at least 15 in mainland). DROM solar water-heater forfaits cut.
Double-flow ventilation (VMC DF) forfaits cut: 4000/3000/2000 -> 3000/2500/1500. Technical criteria for solar thermal equipment (mainland) tightened.

applies_to: applications filed from 2023-01-01; some items from 2023-02-01 and 2023-04-01
content: Extension beyond 2022 of landlord eligibility, AMO, rénovation globale, passoire/BBC bonuses. From 2023-02-01: rénovation globale forfait raised for violet/rose; pellet stoves (3000/2500 -> 2500/2000) and VMC DF (3000/2500 -> 2500/2000) cut by 500 EUR for blue/yellow. From 2023-04-01: insulation forfaits removed for upper-income (rose) households in mainland (e.g. ITE 15 EUR/m2, attic 7 EUR/m2 -> not eligible); fossil heating excluded from rénovation globale bundles. 2022 bonus extended to 2023-03-31 then lapses (air-water heat pump back to 4000/3000/2000).
ne_note: Rose x insulation exit on 2023-04-01 is a clean income x geste design (rose households then have no par-geste forfaits at all). Same day as end of the heat-pump bonus, so separate by geste.

content: Energy audit, fuel-tank removal and AMO fundable only together with at least one other eligible geste. ANAH may reject an application on technical-economic grounds. Only the applicant may create the online account (curbs installer/mandataire-run accounts). Tax notice requested at ANAH discretion. Income ceilings explicitly indexed annually on ANAH ceilings.
ne_note: Anti-fraud tightening aimed at intermediaries. Possible supply-side effect on firms relying on mandataire model.

applies_to: applications filed from 2024-01-01; biomass cut from 2024-04-01
content: 2024 reform. (1) Rénovation globale replaced by 'ensemble de travaux' (Parcours accompagné, mainland): requires Mon Accompagnateur Rénov'; aid = % of HT expense by class gain (violet 45/50%, rose 30/35%; caps 40k/55k/70k for 2/3/4+ classes; +10% for F/G); MAR accompaniment forfait. (2) Par geste: from 2024-07-01 dwelling must be class A-E (F/G excluded); individual houses: gestes 6-12 (insulation, VMC, etc.) only alongside a heating geste (2-5); DPE required. (3) Amounts: air-water heat pump permanently 5000/4000/3000; geothermal 11000/9000/6000; from 2024-04-01 biomass cut (auto boiler 10000/8000/4000 -> 7000/5500/3000; pellet stove 2500/2000/1500 -> 1800/1500/1000). (4) Income ceilings now those of ANAH arrêté 24 May 2013 (MPR annex abrogated); landlords assessed on own household. Landlord rental commitment 6 years; 3-year occupancy for accompagné.
ne_note: Many simultaneous changes (heavy confounding). Best candidates: heat-pump permanent raise vs CET flat; biomass cut 2024-04-01; heating-geste requirement for insulation in houses (only in force 2024-01-01..05-14, see next row).

content: Partial reversal of 2024 reform: F/G exclusion from par geste postponed to 2025-01-01; heating-geste requirement lifted until 2025-01-01; VMC DF must now accompany an insulation geste; DPE requirement for par geste lifted until end 2024. Grants awarded within ANAH's annual commitment budget. Sale agreement accepted at application.
ne_note: On/off design: insulation-only par geste in houses barred 2024-01-01..05-14 then reopened. Announced ~Feb 2024 (to verify). Successive postponements (rows below) mean F/G exclusion never bit through 2026.

content: Parcours accompagné écrêtement: minimum share left to household lowered 40% -> 20% (violet) and 60% -> 50% (rose), i.e. more room to stack MPR with CEE and other aids.
ne_note: Directly relevant to MPR x CEE interaction (co-authors' angle): binding stacking cap relaxed for violet/rose.

content: Postponed to 2026-01-01: F/G par-geste exclusion, heating-geste requirement, DPE requirement. Advances for very-low-income (blue) par geste capped at 50% (was 70%). Parcours accompagné rose rates cut 30/35/35% -> 10/15/20%. Biomass forfaits cut ~30% (auto boiler 7000/5500/3000 -> 5000/3850/2100; pellet stove 1800/1500/1000 -> 1250/1000/750). This biomass cut (art. 4 1°) was annulled by Conseil d'État n°501151 of 2026-03-11.
ne_note: Rose x accompagné cut is large. Biomass cut annulled ex post: legal amounts for 2025 applications uncertain (consolidated text still shows cut values with a nota) - check decision and ANAH practice.

content: New obligations and guarantees for fund-collecting mandataires (intermediaries/installers receiving the prime on behalf of households); required supporting documents.
ne_note: Firm-side: affects installers who advance the prime via mandat de perception.

applies_to: applications filed from 2025-09-30; geste removals from 2026-01-01
content: Parcours accompagné restricted to dwellings classed E-G before works; passoire bonus removed; expense caps 30k (2 classes) / 40k (3+ classes); single rate 45% violet / 10% rose regardless of class gain. Par-geste F/G exclusion, heating requirement and DPE requirement postponed to 2027-01-01. From 2026-01-01: biomass boilers and wall insulation removed from par geste. Optional DPE attestation under the new electricity conversion factor.
ne_note: Reopening of Parcours accompagné after the summer 2025 suspension (suspension itself is not in these texts). Wall insulation and biomass boiler exit from par geste on 2026-01-01.

content: Anti-fraud (loi 2025-594): single ANAH sanctions commission covering MPR, Mon Accompagnateur Rénov' and aides à la pierre; rules for terminating MAR contracts; MAR agreement scope; mandatory administrative appeal for MAR agreement withdrawals.
ne_note: Enforcement tightening; possibly relevant for MAR operator entry/exit.
